In the circumstances which operating environment is changing, enterprises through amend the structure or parameters of model, can automatically adjust their own operating parameters of the information and resources to maintain and adapt to the environment of the operation, and benefit to enterprise to survival lively and develop sustainable in a lasting period of time.

articleTitle: Determinants of the volatility of futures markets price returns: The case of Chinese wheat futures
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper establishes the test models of individual effect and joint effect of the futures price volatility determinants on the basis of GARCH(1,1) model, and takes example for Wheat futures, and analyses empirically the relationship of futures price volatility and time to maturity, of futures price volatility and the day of week, of futures price volatility and volume and open interest. the study results indicate that the price volatility of Wheat futures doesnpsilat exist consistent maturity effect, and maturity effect explains very little of the volatility in futures prices. With respect to the day of week effect, the volatility of futures prices throughout the week is found to be different, the volatility of futures prices on Mondays is higher than the other days of the week, the volatility of futures prices on Friday is lower than the other days of the week, the day of week effect has a little explanation function of volatility. Consistent with the MDH, the results indicate a positive relationship between price volatility and volume, and a negative relationship between price volatility and open interest, and volume and open interest have a larger explanatory power of futures price volatility.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis in short term on the relationship with money supply and price level in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Public keep general attention with the rise of the price level in near two years, especially the variation regard to consumer price index, meanwhile central bank have executed tightening of monetary policy for many times in order to solve the excess liquidity .Public forms the expection of inflation through the new phenomenon about price level rises. This article will adopt the explanation of inflation which is from monetarism school and the theory of Keynes monetary transmission mechanism. Through the analysis of datas of money supply and CPI in every month during 2006 to 2007, exploring the relationship between money supply and phenomenon about price level rises at present. The positive analysis show the price level rose was not caused by money supply amount movement and was caused by the cost of external input.

articleTitle: Social network and agency activity: Wage, efficiency and market mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As a medium for communication and coalition, social network plays an important role in economic activities. This paper aims to study the influence of social network among merchants to agency activities by means of simulation based on corresponding game model. We find that if the average degree of the social network increases, the wage of agents will decrease and social efficiency will increase, but the probability of emergence of third-part institutions such as courts, which is the basis of modern market economy, will decrease. So we can come to the conclusion that the social network with high average degree can encourage the transactions between merchants and agents in short run, but it will restrain the emergence and development of modern market economy.

articleTitle: Research on the capital structure influencing factors applied the data-mining technique: A validating study based on listed companies in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Capital structure is one of the most basic and important research fields in the theory of corporate finance. Most of western corporations keep to the theory of sequence financing made by Myers and make debts as their priority in external financing considering it can enhance the corporate value. In China, however, the strong preference of equity financing and low debt rate is diametrically opposed to the theory of capital structure and financing sequence. This paper validates the applicability of the theory of capital structure in China by applying the data-mining technique. It is committed to optimizing Chinese corporationspsila capital structures by pointing out the corresponding relationship between the portfolio of corporation characters and different capital structures.

articleTitle: Study on modular motivation planning synergy decision-making base on knowledge innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The article provides a modular motivation synergy planning base on knowledge innovation character. First, The author describes knowledge innovation modular model, signed explicit knowledge innovation modular and tacit knowledge innovation modular through knowledge partition from three dimension second, it attempts to elucidate the integration power of the concept of modular motivation connotation in the context of understanding the effective performance of modular motivation in complex knowledge innovation system. Third, the author adopt method of dynamics analysis to explain knowledge innovation driving, analysis motivation synergy character, synergy degree of modular motivation is defined and calculated according to the theory of Synergetic the final segment of the paper provides an illustration with explanation on how motivation synergy planning is considered and selected. This paper suggests that modular motivation synergy strategy can provide a kind of way and path for inspiring knowledge innovation and enhance motivation effect. The paper shows the nature of motivation synergy, offers an explanation of optimized motivation planning.

articleTitle: Building coal storage centre to settle the problem of power generation coal supply based on KPCA-SVRM
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper is established in electricity lines, and put forward the viewpoint that we can build coal storage center to settle the problem of power generation coal supply. Make the coal storage centre site selection by using KPCA (kernel principal component analysis) -SVRM (support vector regression machine), taking all factors into account, and making the advantage of the social division of labor specialization fully played. In KPCA-SVRM, the first step is to apply KPCA to SVRM for feature extraction. KPCA first maps the original inputs into a high dimensional feature space using the kernel method and then calculates PCA in the high dimensional feature space. These new features are then used as the inputs of SVRM to solve the site selection problem. By learning and training, we use the data of this subset to get the solution and find interrelationship of input and output by the SVRM. Practical examples are cited in this paper to illustrate the process.

articleTitle: Research on the implementation mechanism of synergetic management pattern system for manufacturing firms
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the research of the order parameter principle and the slave principle, this paper regards the management pattern system of manufacturing firms as a complex system which is composed by the mission subsystem, the technology subsystem, the human resources subsystem and the organization subsystem. Its implementation rules conform to the characteristics of the self-organization systems. The paper studies the interaction among the four subsystems and at the same time regards the coordination degree among the four subsystems as the order parameter of the synergetic management pattern system (SMPS) for manufacturing firms. Then this paper establishes an index system, and based on these, finally gives a coordination evaluating model. If the system could not harmoniously operate, managers in the manufacturing firms could take certain measures to make the whole system go to effective implementation.

articleTitle: A Pareto-improved mode in resource-limited industry
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Starting from the analysis on the existence of maximum marginal cost in most natural resources, the relationship between production mode and sustainable development of resources-limited industry has been discussed in this paper, within the framework of classical economic theory. An operable Pareto-improved production mode of ldquoalternation of using and reserving; production with limited outputrdquo has been proposed and demonstrated explicitly. To estimate above mode, the amended demand curve has been reasoned under the precondition of limited production, which is based on the Sluscky consumer utility function. Furthermore, the total social welfare as the well as producer profit and consumer utility have been analyzed mathematically.

articleTitle: Research on the effect of service guarantee on customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As a method to effectively improve the customerspsila satisfaction, service guarantee should be applied in more and more service companies. This study is focus on the effect of service guarantee on the customer satisfaction, the investigation of the relationship among service guarantee, customer expectation, perceived risk and perceived value. Four attributes of service guarantee such as restrictiveness, appropriateness, confidence and convenience are arranged as the customer expectation, perceived risk and perceived value are presented as the mediating variables. Based on the background of domestic catering industry, this study has investigated the effects of service guarantee on customer satisfaction. The results show that a successful service guarantee should be less restrictive in conditions, reliable and concise in contents, appropriate in promise. Finally, we bring forward some suggestions for company marketing.

articleTitle: Can bidder’s buying patterns affect the price in online auctions for heterogeneous goods?
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Until recently, there have little reason for any one to pay much attention to what factors will affect the final transaction price in online auctions. While almost all of the existing papers on the determinants of price are based on homogeneous goods, this paper investigates the determinants of the price for heterogeneous goods contained in some categories which are sold at the eBay website from the viewpoint of sellerpsilas buying patterns. The empirical results suggest that some factors such as the second price, the number of bidders, and the presence of insurance had positive and significant impacts on the final price. The sellerpsilas reputation has a positive, but limited impact on a buyerpsilas willingness to pay for an auction item. In contrast, the closing time features such as closing on weekend or in the evening do not have significant impacts on the auction price.

articleTitle: Analysis on industry entering based on routine
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Selecting a certain industry is the primary task of enterprise strategic management. Before entering a certain industry, the enterprise must do a deep analysis on the target industry, and one of the most important aspects is to investigate the target industrypsilas routines. Industry routines formed in a long time is a special arrangement in order. The enterprise needs to consider whether its former routines adapt to the industry routines. If the enterprise canpsilat, it should change its former routines and gain new routines which are adaptive by search and innovation.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of the supporting environment on the venture capital development role
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper uses the multiple regression analysis and the structural equation modeling (SEM) to study the relationship between venture capital and supporting environment. The empirical analysis results show that, the corporation leading science technology environment (CLSTE) and the government supportive policies synthesis level (GSPSL) have direct effects on the development of VC; the development level of economy (DLE) and the CLSTE, the development pattern of economy (DPE) and the GSPSL interact to promote the development of VC. Therefore, in order to develop VC, it must optimize the economic environment (EE), cultivate the CLSTE and perfect the GSPE.

articleTitle: Cheap talk of supply-demand games in the world oil market
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The skyrocketing of the oil price aroused the attention to the supply-demand relationship of the world oil market. Aiming at the incomplete information between suppliers and consumers, this paper studied the production strategy of the suppliers and the judgment of the consumers of the oil market with a signaling game model to deduce the sufficient and essential conditions of the three kinds of market equilibria---separating equilibrium, pooling equilibrium and hybrid equilibrium, and finally made comparison between the three market efficiencies. The result is that the separating equilibrium is the most efficient Bayesian equilibrium of the above three. So the suppliers will transmit correct signals as long as the cost of cheating is high enough and the most efficient market equilibrium could be achieved.

articleTitle: Research on the contribution of human capital accumulation to the economic growth in three provinces of Northeast China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the model of Cobb-Douglas production function, this paper measures the contribution rate of human capital accumulation by education (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub>) and higher education (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub>) for the economic growth in three provinces of Northeast China during 1990-2005. The estimation value of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> for Heilongjiang, Jilin and Liaoning is 11.80%, 10.26% and 10.12% respectively, and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub> is 1.40%, 1.25% and 1.55% respectively. Further analysis result shows that: both C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub> of northeast China are lower than the national level and are far below the level of western countries; although compared with the 1990s, the years of education per capita and the average annual GDP growth rate of northeast region during 2001-2005 has greatly improved, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub> of three provinces have declined; C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub> is influenced by the some important factors such as the degree of market competition, the correlation between higher education and economy, educational input. So in order to promote the contribution of human capital accumulation to economic growth, the three provinces of Northeast China should focus on these factors to take relevant countermeasures.

articleTitle: Dynamical interdependence analysis in the stock indices of the East Asian economies
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The contagion of the financial crisis became more and more evident since 1990s. Numerous channels make the financial crisis contagion have notable nonlinear features. The traditional research are mostly based on the linear methods, which have limitation to investigate the nonlinear features. The dynamical interdependence analysis method in this paper is better than the linear methods to depict the nonlinear dynamical features of the financial crisis contagion.

articleTitle: Strategic management in transport: Essence and leadership to strategy implementation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Strategic management in transport is accompanied by dynamism and uncertainty of environment. Successful strategy implementation consists in realization of the strategic plan of the enterprise, it means mobilizing employees and manager to put formulated strategies into action. Strategic leadership includes not only skill to be the strategist, but also the politician, the businessman, the administrator and the instructor simultaneously. Management is a team process. Only in teamwork we can receive synergetic effect. Management should in proper time provide receipt of all necessary resources and first of all financial. System of compensation defines readiness and aspiration of the worker to perform the charged work qualitatively and in due time. Also the important component of process of strategy implementation is training of the personnel.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the effects of entrepreneurial traits on entrepreneurial orientation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper constructs a theory model in order to study how entrepreneurial traits affect entrepreneurial orientation. And in this study the dimensions of entrepreneurial traits include need for achievement, risk propensity and locus of control; The dimensions of entrepreneurial orientation include innovativeness, risk taking and proactiveness. Then we empirically study how entrepreneurial traits affect entrepreneurial orientation by multiple regression analysis, and the results show entrepreneurial traits positively affect entrepreneurial orientation, except that two hypotheses: ldquoNeed for achievement positively affects proactiveness and Risk propensity positively affects proactivenessrdquo are not supported. In short, this paper not only enriches the entrepreneurial management theory but also gives some references for scholars to study entrepreneurship.

articleTitle: Study on coupling logistics developing and industry developing stage —taking China green food industry as an example
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Logistics has close relation with the development of industries and enterprises, and different logistics development strategies should be planed and implemented for different kinds of industries and enterprises at different developing stage which is a dynamic evolvement process. With the model of industry growth analysis and autoregressive distributed lag (ADL) model, the conclusion is drawn that the green food industry of China has entered the middle term of growth stage and the development level of third party-logistics has become the important factor that has effect on the development of green food industry. The following problems are brought forward that the development of logistics lags behind relatively, and the management level is also relative low, and suggestions that strengthen the management of logistics strategy to optimize its structure and enhance the competition advantage of industry in both domestic and abroad market are also put forward.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation and application of standard competition capacity
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Standard competition capacity means enterprisespsila capability of effecting technical standards formation and transformation, and making their own technologies to be industrial standards partially or completely. In order to hold the situation of standard competition and purposely establish proper standard competition strategy and tactics, it is one of crucial bases for enterprises to evaluate their standard competition capacity quantitatively. Firstly, this paper establishes a theoretical framework for evaluating standard competition capacity through analyzing mechanisms of standard competition, then establishes index of evaluation for standard competition capacity. Secondly, an evaluation model is constructed by grey relational analysis. Finally, the model is applied to evaluate several enterprisespsila standard competition capacity. The framework proposed in this paper analyzes standard competition from a systematic perspective, introduces institutional attributes of industrial standard into an analyzing framework and helps comprehend the mechanism of establishing and transferring standard completely. The method has acquired favorable effect in practice.

articleTitle: PRED system and the strategy of urban development in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Research on coordination among population(P), resources(R), environment(E) and development(D) (PRED) has comprehensive and extensive contents, which serves as the core of sustainable development. According to the characteristics of urban PRED system, 50 representative cities and 20 indexes from both positive and negative sides are selected to establish an index system, which applies multiple indexes comprehensive evaluation method to evaluate the development step of urban PRED system. Furthermore, 50 cities could be classified into four classes shown the sameness and the difference. The results are also revealed that the development step of Chinapsilas urban PRED system has great difference, so we could give different development strategy for the four classes. The research would provide a theoretical basis for Chinapsilas urbanization strategy.

articleTitle: A model of horizontal merger based on shareholder-competition and firm debt
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Merger is a relatively rapid and convenient means for firms to expand and enhance competitive ability. The existing literatures take no account of the fact that therepsilas debt in most firmspsila capital structure, whereas take the object of M&A as to maximize the firm value change. However, the decision-makers should be the stockholders of both firms, thus the merger object is to maximize the equity value. Applying the analysis method of contingent claim pricing, this paper constructs a merger model based on shareholders maximizing equity value, and finds the necessary conditions of merger, containing some linear or non-linear functions. The numerical results are significant, showing that the debt scale of the both firms affects the merger threshold, and the threshold grows higher as the debt scale grows. Although our study is only on horizontal mergers, it contributes to better understanding the effect of debt.

articleTitle: Excess monetary liquidity and asset prices in China: An empirical investigation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This article examines the long run relationship between M2-to-GDP ratio, the indictor of excess liquidity, and asset prices for China through cointegration estimation procedure. It also implements the Vector Error Correction Models (VECM) to explore simultaneously the short- and long-run causation in the modeling process. Results from the cointegration tests reveal that excess liquidity, asset prices, and the growth rate of household deposit share long run equilibrium relationship, while the results from the VECM indicate the absence of short run causality between excess liquidity and asset prices, but in the long run asset price and the growth rate of household deposit have casual influence on excess liquidity. In addition, the study finds that there is unidirectional causality from the growth rate of household deposit to the stock price in the short run but not vice versa.

articleTitle: Organizational learning and innovation —research based on different ownership identity
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on knowledge management theory, this research formed a structure equation model about the impact of organizational learning on innovation. Then, based on institutional theory, we compared the differences of these relationships in Chinese state-owned companies and non-state-owned companies. We found that the differences are significant in companies with different ownership identities.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis of cash payback capacity in nonperforming asset pool
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The factors were analysed which affects the cash payback capacity of nonperforming asset pool. Correlation was analysed to the factors and there exists multicollinearity. All Kaiser Meyer Olkin measure (KMO measure) exceeded 0.5. It showed that the sample was adequate and suitable for principal component analysis. The contribution proportion of cumulative variance decided the principal components. The empirical results show housing price index is the the first principal component. It decreases 1 percent, then the payback capacity score drops 2.14% correspondingly. The range is larger than that of the nonmain elements. A linear equation evaluates cash payback capacity of nonperforming asset pool. The principal component analysis provides an effective means to weigh the safety bonds scale and a reference to investors to invest in interbank bond market.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain optimal capacity combination based on hybrid Petri nets
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Supply chain systems are hybrid dynamic systems composed of continuous elements such as supply, production, distribution performed by supplier, manufacturer, distributor, discrete element such as transportation, demand performed by logistics company, consumer. Traditional method of modeling supply chain looking supply chain as discrete event system or continuous time system canpsilat reflect dynamic character or random character. A hybrid Petri nets model of supply chain is developed with a discrete-continuous combined modeling approach in this paper. Global conflicts are solved by solving multi-object programming model. Local conflicts are solved by setting fixed rate and local priority. Through solving optimal firing speed of continuous transitions in hybrid Petri nets model, optimal capacity combination is obtained under the uncertainty condition of consumer demand, waster rate of production and transportation disruption.

articleTitle: A case-based reasoning system for mechanical design
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Mechanical design, mainly depending on the expert experience, is a complicated, uncertain and unstructured activity. Although mechanical products can be designed by skilled designers, the design process is still time-consuming and experience-dependent. To solve this problem, this paper develops a system applying case-based reasoning (CBR) methodology to support mechanical design process. In the CBR system, the case-base is divided into two parts, one is standard case-base and the other is design case-base, which can improve the matching efficiency of the standardization parts. A retrieval algorithm integrated with the clustering technique is proposed to locate the similar cases in the case-base. In addition, a test case-base is proposed to illustrate the feasibility of the CBR system.

articleTitle: Research on the sustainable development in ecology energy region based on the ecology industry paragenesis
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Along with energy large-scale development, the ecological environment in energy region has been seriously polluted and destroyed. How to expand economic scales of the energy region, to strengthen the load bearing capacity of the ecology, and to guarantee the long-term sustainable development unceasingly is an urgent problem to solve. In this article, through simulating the natural ecosystem, we establish mutually beneficial, paragenesis networks of ecology industry for the energy region, and form the cycle systems which include ldquothe most superior production, the most superior consumption and the least wastesrdquo. In order that we can achieve the development goal of economic benefits, environment benefits as well as social benefits, and guarantee sustainable development of the energy region.

articleTitle: Efficient sampling strategies for large-scale complex networks
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In empirical research on large-scale complex networks, sampling is a necessary way to collect data. Current methods commonly-used are Y2H-derived partial sampling strategy and random sampling strategy. Some recent studies have proposed that subnets sampled by these methods may not accurately conserve structural properties of the original network. Therefore, how to improve the accuracy of data collection is raised as a significant problem. We present an effective strategy for sampling in complex networks. The proposed strategy, hub strategy, calls for targeting the highly connected node samples. We demonstrate that in contrast with current sampling methods, hub sampling strategy keeps multiple structural properties of networks more accurately as well as being more economical. Furthermore, we find that when sampling rate decreases, hierarchical modularity is easier to be distorted quantitatively by hub sampling than the other structural properties.

articleTitle: Sustainable development-based evaluation model for investment efficiency of the residential district
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Residential real estate is invested overheated in a long time in China, and excessive residential districts were constructed. However, the investment efficiency was not considered adequately. At the same time, the concept of sustainable development gets gradual perfection, which is widely used in evaluations. An evaluation model based on analytical hierarchy process (AHP) technique for investment efficiency of residential districts, considering sustainable developmentpsila requirement is presented in this paper. The model developed consists of three components: evaluation index system, relative weightings and result analyses. These were based on the quantitative data provided by 27 experts in relevant fields, who are residential district investors, architects and designers, urban planners, environmental experts, sociologists. The applicability, reliability and accuracy are proved by a case study.

articleTitle: Research on establishment of trade market for property right of mineral resources in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the method of theoretical analysis this paper systematically introduces some important viewpoints of market exchange for property right of mineral resources according to the Interest-value Theory, which is the results of the project of National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC), named Interest-value Theory and Problems of Capitalization for Mineral resources (project No.79670094). For example, the total value of a property right of mineral resources equals the sum of values capitalized, the items of the values capitalized include the values of purchasing a mining concession of mineral resources, the values of managerial fees collected by administrative authorities and the values of expenses occurred during exploring mineral resources. The new proposal about trade market for mineral resources with method of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) in operational research for evaluations of mineral resources traded, the platform of electric -marketing and the new tax mode for matching this new market are also submitted on the basis of these important viewpoints. Establishing national trade market for property rights of mineral resources and newly adding purchase-tax of mineral resources in the trade of property rights of mineral resources are strongly recommended, and the main steps of establishing national trade market are given by the author at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: Constructing the relationship between concepts in government ontology based on E-Government Thesauri
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The paper first reviews the present situation of the construction of ontology in China; then introduces the general e-government thesaurus and reviews the relationships between terms. The authors discuss the basic relationships and summarize 15 relationships between the classes in government ontology. Furthermore, in order to construct government ontology based on the general e-government thesaurus, the semantic relationships between terms of the thesaurus need to be adapted. So the authors present the idea of facet reform of the general e-government thesaurus, and analyze the application of facet thesaurus in the construction of government ontology. Finally, a case which takes the class of ldquoproductrdquo as an example is given to demonstrate that. The paper aims to summarize relationships between concepts in the construction of government ontology.

articleTitle: Stock price informativeness and corporate investment efficiency:Evidence from Chinese manufacturing listed companies between 2001 and 2005
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Despite claims that stock price informativeness can have economic implications for investment efficiency, there is little evidence on this relation empirically. By the use of Durnev et al. (2003) firm-year measure of stock price informativeness, the paper studies the effect of stock price informativeness on corporate investment efficiency based on corporate level on a sample of Chinese manufacturing listed companies from 2001 to 2005. The empirical results indicate: stock price informativeness is negatively associated with both listed companiespsila overinvestment and underinvestment. It also eliminates the possibility that the negative correlation is caused by the case that managers decrease stock price informativeness to conceal the investment losses. Further, stock price informativeness can decrease the sensitivity of overinvestment to free cash flow and the sensitivity of underinvestment to financing constraints. The paper finally confirms the conclusion from the angle of corporate performance. Overall, this paper has implications for research examining the determinants of investment efficiency and the economic consequences of stock price informativeness.

articleTitle: Multidimensional managerial coaching behavior and its impact on employee performance
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Managerial coaching is an important management technology of human resource development to improve individual performance; yet, few empirical studies have examined the role of managerial coaching in improving employeespsila performance. Using a sample which consists of 340 managers from 38 organizations, the study explores the four types of managerial coaching behavior as following: self-awareness enlightenment, psychological support, vocational development, and role modeling. Then the study further examines the relationship between managerial coaching behaviors and employee performance. The results of structural equation modeling (SEM) analysis show that all of four types of managerial coaching behavior have positive influences on contextual performance, and self-awareness enlightenment and role modeling have positive influences on task performance. The study proves the necessity to implement managerial coaching for the improving the employee performance.

articleTitle: Abnormally low tender problem in public works
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to determine the problems due to abnormally low tenders (ALTs) and to develop some methods for reducing the negative effects of ALTs. In this paper, the reasons of ALTs, recommendations to eliminate ALTs were investigated. According to this investigation, it was observed that results change due to different social structures of countries. In addition to this investigation, ALT evaluation questionnaire was prepared to determine reasons of ALTs. The ALT evaluation questionnaire reached to 400 companies. 18 questions were asked to the companies. Qualitative statistical methods were used to analyze correlation between variables. Comprehensive analysis was applied to the questionnaire and reasons behind ALTs were determined. Finally, some recommendations are proposed to professionals.

articleTitle: Research on the evolution of enterprises’ knowledge space-time in the techno-innovation process under the network environment
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The knowledge-space of the network is constructed in this paper whose dimension is depicted by the innovative product as vertex of the space. The techno-innovation process is taken as a translation from n-dimensional space to one-dimensional space firstly. And then, from the microscopic perspective and macroscopic perspective, the evolution of the knowledge base in the process is studied respectively in this paper. At the microscopic level, the evolution of the knowledge base is divided into the iterative sequence of the enterprisepsilas knowledge basepsilas border in the information-flow process and the process is modeled with the help of the fractal theory. At the macroscopic level, the correlation is discussed among the information output of the enterprises as the information sources and the entropy character of the knowledge base evolution, by making use of the information-flow cycle with the maximum entropy equation. The conclusion can be reference for the knowledge base of the techno-innovation process and the management of the enterprisespsila knowledge.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the interrelation between US FDI in China and Sino-US economic growth
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Nowadays, US foreign direct investment (FDI) has become not only one of material resources for Chinapsilas foreign capital introduction, but also important way to absorb advanced technology and management experience. This paper is an empirical research on the interrelation between the US FDI in China and Sino-US economic growth, adopting Johansen cointegration test, the Vector Error Correction Model and variance decomposition technology, based on analytical data in the period from 1983 to 2006. The studying result implies that it is the economic growth in China, rather than that in the US, that is the Granger cause of the US FDI in China; Both the US FDI in China and the economic growth in China are the Granger causalities of the economic growth in the US; But neither the US FDI in China nor the US economic growth is the Granger cause for the economic growth in China.

articleTitle: Causes of fluctuation in the current account balance of Pakistan
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Balance of current account has an important role in the economic growth of a country. Pakistan is among those countries who have been suffering from the problem of current account deficit and this problem has become chronic over many decades. This study has been aimed to investigate the factors that cause fluctuation in the current account balance. In this paper, we utilized cointegration and error correction modeling techniques. The empirical results advocate that there exists a significant long term relationship between the current account balance and the balance export, import, total consumption, and workers remittances during the observed period 1972 to 2005.

articleTitle: Study on China State-owned enterprise management platform based on competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper expounds the analytic method of State-owned enterprisepsilas management platform from the view of competitiveness. It takes saving of management-process-cost for main research object of State-owned enterprisepsilas management platform, and analyzes enterprisepsilas management platform theory from the perspective of management concept, property right system, organization form and management technology. The conclusion is that the regularity characteristics of contemporary effective enterprisepsilas management platform are: (1) establishing the idea of human-oriented scientific management; (2) establishing the sound modern enterprise system and deepening the reform of property rights system is the basic system security to improve the management efficiency of state-owned enterprises; (4) it is of great significance to establish a team-cooperation- organization for the purpose of combining industry objectives, aiming at state-owned enterprisespsila ldquolarge and all-embracing modelrdquo. (4) improving the ability to use modern technology means and establishing comprehensive information management system throughout the business process, etc.

articleTitle: A research on the impact of symbolic meaning of commodities on the conspicuous consumption behavior
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper mainly analyses conspicuous consumption behavior and its influencing factors from marketing point of view. The objectives it observes are peoplepsilas attitude of high-grade commodities through questionnaires surveys. Sorted out on the basis of the literatures, it puts forward an integrate framework model in order to explain the factors that influence conspicuous consumption behavior and the extent they influence it. The main variables in this model are : Symbolic meanings of commodities, status consumption, the influence of referenced group, face consciousness and conspicuous consumption. The main conclusions are as follows:the symbolic meanings of commodities, status consumption, face consciousness and the influence of referenced group have positive influence on conspicuous consumption behavior. The sense of ascription to a society has notable positive impact on wealth conspicuous, but the consumption styles of referenced group have negative impact on wealth consumption. Furthermore, it advances the significances of its empirical studies to management, and some problems that need to be solved in further research.

articleTitle: The theory of innovation and its application in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper introduces the different views of innovation and expatiates on the national/ sub-national innovation system, including the basic functions, characteristics and models of the national/sub-national innovation systems. A mathematic model of an innovation system is brought forward. Then the innovation system is analyzed with the method of system dynamics. And two causal loop diagrams are given the with cases study of the university sub-system and enterprise sub-system in the innovation system. Besides, the evaluation of innovation system is discussed. Finally, the application of innovation theory in China is introduced, which includes the development of national innovation system and the sub-national innovation systems in The Pan-Pearl River Delta Area, Yangtze River Delta Area and Bo-hai Sea Rim Area. The authors also give some suggestions on construction innovation system.

articleTitle: An empirical study on China saving-city evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The saving city (SC) evaluation is an important means to promote the construction process of saving city. According to the concept and characteristics of the SC, following the scientific, practical and operational principles, taking the present situation of our country into consideration, the paper firstly puts forward an evaluation index system for SC, which includes 4 levels, 3 subsystems and 25 variables; Secondly, using the multivariate statistical analysis theory, the paper sets up a comprehensive evaluation model based on the Factor Analysis method (FA) for the evaluation of SC; Thirdly, by means of SPSS software system, this paper makes an empirical study based on the actual data of 17 cities in some province. The result shows that: the index system and evaluation model have a good practicability and maneuverability. It will provide means for monitoring and evaluation of the construction of SC for the government and the relevant authorities.

articleTitle: Impact of exchange rate on delocalization decisions of multinational enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, using real option pricing theory, the production or sales delocalization flexibility for multinational enterprises making decisions is modeled as exchange option under multifactor of uncertainty, such as stochastic exchange rate, labor costs or product price. The paper presents the option valuation of delocalization production or sale abroad and the optimal investment decision rules in that include the optimal threshold value of delocalization production abroad and the optimal threshold value of sale abroad. The paper also discuss that the effect of important parameters on the optimal threshold value of delocalization product or sales. Finally, numerical simulations for the delocalization decision rules are given and show that this delocalization decision rules are operable in application.

articleTitle: Barriers and solutions of e-commerce in China: An exploratory study
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Due to the considerably big marketplace, enterprises seek to benefit from e-commerce in China. But up to now very few of them have been successful, because some successful business models and strategies in developed countries can not be applied in China. This study examines obstacles on e-commerce development in China and attempts to find out some solutions to overcome these barriers. The relevant data was gathered by a questionnaire and the review of two successful Chinese e-commerce companies, and it revealed that the two most important factors affecting customers’ participation of the e-commerce are lack of trust due to Internet security and Privacy concerns and lack of customer service. This study also confirms that consumers’ attitude and intention to participate in e-commerce behaviors can be improved effectively by the transformation about the laws and legislations related to e-commerce in China.

articleTitle: The impact of reputation system on C2C online sales: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Despite the wide research of reputation system of C2C online markets, there are few empirical studies outside the United States. Whether theories of C2C online sales which are developed in the US could be applied to a different national and cultural context is still open to question. With the fast growth in Chinapsilas electronic markets, especially in the C2C online markets, it has become increasingly important to study the determinants of C2C online sales in China. This paper focuses on one of the most important factors, namely, reputation system to make conclusions and comparison between China and the US. An empirical study is conducted based on data from Taobao - the largest C2C auction site in China. Reputation system has been shown to have significant effect on C2C online sales. Positive ratings have been demonstrated to result in better selling performance, while the impact of negative ratings is volatile and not significant in some cases.

articleTitle: Effects of trust in leader on organizational citizenship behavior and team performance: Empirical evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The present study extended previous research by proposing and empirically testing the relationship between trust in leader and team performance and the model of mediating processes underlying the relationship. The survey was conducted in 75 work team from several cities in China. The hierarchical regression results showed that trust in team leader involved cognition-based trust and affect-based trust, these two forms of trust were positively related to team performance. Contrasting to the cognition-based trust, affect-based trust had stronger effects on team performance. The organizational citizenship behaviour partially mediated the relationship between trust in team leader and team performance. That was, trust in leader directly influenced team performance at one hand, and had indirect effect on team performance via organizational citizenship behaviour on the other hand. At last, the theoretical and empirical implication was discussed.

articleTitle: On Natural Gas price mechanism given present context of China’s natural gas industry
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As the efficient clean natural resource, natural gas has become the world top choice of ameliorating environment and promoting sustainable development on economy. It is estimated by International Information Center of Natural Gas that in 2000 world primary consumption gross of natural gas is 2.5 tril cubes, which accounts for 22% of the total consumption of non-renewable resource. As a result of competitive price and ecologic predominance comparing to other fuels, it is expected that world consumption of natural gas will continually increase. And before 2020, annual growth rate can reach 2.7%. It will be one of the important approaches for China to develop natural gas resource to change the structure of energy resources. It is decided by market economy that the basic tropism of price reform of natural resources is market pricing. It is the key to study on natural gas price mechanism. The price management mode of natural gas pricing should turn from primary ldquocost-oriented, governmental-pricing and strict-supervision-and-managementrdquo to ldquounfastening-supervision-and-management, gasoline-connection, standard-price and floatingrdquo. Finally, the price of natural gas should be opened to turn from governmental supervision and management to market pricing. This thesis attempts to analyze the important role government plays and its role diversion in reform of natural gas pricing mechanism from present condition and development of Chinapsilas natural gas price.

articleTitle: Comparison and investigation on income disparity in China and western developed countries
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Since the reform and opening in 1980s, China has been going through a rapid develop era in national economy, however, the issue of income disparity has also been increased dramatically to become a notable issue disturbing the harmony of society and stability of economic growth. Here we compared data on income disparity from China and western countries and indicated commonness that led to the increasing of income gap throughout the world, namely supply-and-demand for manpower capital, international trade and progress in technology. We analyzed various factors that influence income difference in China as well as other countries and thereafter suggested that the Chinese-specific complications on income difference mainly exist in natural factors and illogicality in distribution system. Based on these studies of different embodiments between China and other countries, we proposed solutions to decrease the income gap in China.

Author Keywords: study on cases in China and other countries

articleTitle: Study on multi-objective flexible production scheduling based on improved immune algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Because of multi objective, multi-constraint, dynamic flexible process route and complex modeling, multi-objective flexible job shop scheduling (MOFJS) is more complicated than the classical job shop scheduling, and therefore it canpsilat generally been solved by the ordinary optimization methods. Firstly, the model of MOFJS is set up. Secondly, immune algorithm based on excellence holding is put forward. In the algorithm, the best antibodies are held and utilized by immunity memory and the local best genes are held and utilized by immunity vaccine in every alternation to accelerate algorithm convergence. Thirdly, in view of the flexible process route of the scheduling, a novel double layer antibody coding method based on operation and machine is brought forward, and an effective decoding method based on machine capability space is developed. In addition, the multi objective ranking evaluation technique is adopted to evaluate and optimize several contradiction objectives, such as time, equipment and cost. Finally, the availability and the superiority of the algorithm, the strategy and the model are validated by the simulation of benchmark job shop scheduling problems and the scheduling instance of Xipsilaan Aero-engine (Group) LTD, in China.

articleTitle: Subjective assessment by entrepreneurs and venture financing for startup enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: An entrepreneurpsilas assessment of his entrepreneurial project and the investor is a major factor that influences the venture financing for the startup enterprise. We build a decision making model for venture financing with the entrepreneur as the central decision maker and provide a theoretical analysis of the main factors that influence the venture financing of the startup enterprise and the operating mechanisms of such factors. The results of the analysis show that: (1) The higher the entrepreneur rates the project quality, the more venture capital he is willing to attract; however, this tendency will gradually weaken. (2) In the entrepreneurpsilas mind there might exist a ldquocritical pointrdquo with regard to the judgment of probability: if the entrepreneurpsilas assessed probability of success for the entrepreneurial project exceeds the critical point, his rating of the probability of success is positively correlated to the amount of venture capital that he is willing to introduce. (3) The more investorpsilas non-monetary resources as perceived by the entrepreneur, the less venture capital the entrepreneur would be willing to introduce; however, this tendency will gradually weaken. (4) The greater gap between the investorspsila and the entrepreneurspsila assessments of the startup enterprise, the less venture capital the entrepreneur would be willing to absorb.

articleTitle: The research about the issues of firm survival by life table methods —an empirical research based on the samples of Hunan’s firms
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Using the life table methods, this paper analyses the enterprises which were established after 1980 in Hunan Province, then it makes a comparative study of median survival time from the angle of cities, industries, capital size, type of ownership and the establishment time and the results show that there is a big difference in survival time of enterprises with different cities, industry, capital size, type of ownership of enterprises and the establishment time. This paper explained and analyzed the differences, the results showed that Chinese enterprises living conditions are not only impacted by of geographic of the business, industry and the scale in the traditional Western theory of industrial organization, but also are impacted by the nature of the ownership and the establishment time which are determined by Chinapsilas national conditions.

articleTitle: The spatial distribution of real estate taxes impacts on housing price in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present some empirical findings on the spatial distribution of real estate taxes impacts on housing price in China. The fixed effect regression model was used to estimate this effect with data of the 31 provinces and metropolis in 1998-2006. The fording showed that: (1) real estate taxes had both direct and indirect impact on housing price. The direct effect was real estate taxes capitalization, and the indirect effects were referred as the capitalization of public services deriving from the real estate taxes revenues. (2) Real estate taxes had a negative effect on housing price in China. If the collected real estate taxes increased at 1 percentage, housing price would increase at 0.038 percentage, but if local public expenditure increased at 1 percentage, housing price would increase at 0.398 percentages. (3) The real estate taxes burden effect on housing price in central districts of China was much more obvious than Western China, and this effect in Eastern China was not obvious. The reason for the results could be explained to some extent as the spatial difference of local public expenditure.

articleTitle: Study on managing effects of information technology applied on transportation
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Environmental pollution, traffic accident and so on, all these externality problems caused by transportation conflicted with the accepted social sustainable development. Many countries adopted the pollution control, transportation regulation or other restrictive policy to solve the problems, but on the whole had little effect. To show new thoughts to this problem, the paper studies the measures by using information technology (IT) based on evaluating qualitatively two forms of managing effect, substitutive effect and stimulative effect, of IT application on transportation, through analysis of data related to the freight turnover and the number of telephone in China from 1952 to 1998, reveals their close and perplexing relationship, takes simulative analysis in the case of a city, and concludes some findings, enlightenment and proposals to the corresponding further study.

articleTitle: Interorganization transfer of knowledge in cooperative R&D: An empirical research on machinery and IT industries
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The purpose of the study is an attempt to find out and examine the factors affecting the effectiveness of interorganizations knowledge transfer in the process of collaborative R&D in mechanism manufacturing and IT industries in China. On the basis of literature research and interviews with collaborative R&D organizations, a knowledge transfer influencing factors theoretical framework is proposed. The empirical study is conducted through a research survey by questionnaire on mechanism manufacturing and IT industries. This study constructs SEM model and uses multivariate statistic analysis tools, AMOS7.0, to verify the relations of variables. A total of 143 respondents were samples. The results of the study indicates that the higher degree of ldquoknowledge transfer processrdquo, the higher degree of ldquoeffectiveness of knowledge transferrdquo; ldquoresources involvementrdquo, ldquoknowledge context applicabilityrdquo and ldquoknowledge transfer meansrdquo are significantly and positively related to ldquoknowledge transfer processrdquo; ldquothe information symmetryrdquo is highly related to ldquoknowledge identifying abilityrdquo; and ldquoknowledge identifying abilityrdquo which doesnpsilat directly relate to ldquoknowledge transfer processrdquo but positively correlates with ldquoknowledge transfer meansrdquo; ldquothe disseminative capability of the knowledge sendersrdquo and ldquothe absorptive capability of recipientrdquo positively and significantly correlates with ldquoknowledge context applicabilityrdquo.

articleTitle: Research on the technology innovation mode selection of cross-administrative regions in northeast manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper begins with the connotation of innovation theory of cross-administrative regions, analyses the operation and development of the cross-administrative regions innovation system and the relationship between administrative regions and economic regions; and then discusses the classification and character of technology innovation mode and the key factors of technology innovation mode selection, and analyses the mode of independent innovation and imitative innovation, and its differences. Finally, based on the above theory, the paper has constructed the technology innovation mode of northeast manufacturing------an approach of enhancing strong points and avoiding weaknesses, conducting with imitative innovation, aiming at independent innovation and initiating the dynamic cooperation innovation alliance. It also need some measures to guarantee the execution after determining the development strategy of technology innovation mode in northeast manufacturing, therefore, making the contribution for enhancing of innovation ability in northeast.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation on CEOs financial supervision environment based on multilevel matter element model
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Because of pursuing different benefits, during the acting, there are some conflicts between clients and agents. When agents go in for their benefits, it is possible to damage clientspsila benefits. Thus, clients must build a set of balance measures to restrict CEOs and reduce agent cost. Reasons begetting CEOspsila financial fraud is various, so it is difficult to make the part of balance to be considerate. It is necessary to evaluate the environment around manager financial supervision, to find out which segment should be improved. By choosing representative indexes, construct the estimate indexes system of environment system. Then adopting AHP to fix the weights and choosing the multilevel mater-elements in comprehensive extension evaluation to build a environment estimate system model. This model can provide feasible methods for CEOs enterprise financial supervision evaluation. It has been verified empirically that the model have a better result to evaluate the environment system of financial monitors to managers effectively.

articleTitle: A study of mechanism of urban residential segregation based on housing consumer preference
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper uses Hedonic theory to deduce that the degree of residential segregation depends on the degree of consumer preference for location, and consumer preference for different location attribute will result in the different urban space structure. Based on the theoretical analysis, this paper introduces structural equation model to conduct an empirical analysis in Xipsilaan housing market. The results show that consumers have the greatest preference for the location of houses in comparison with neighborhood conditions along with the structural conditions, which results in the clearer residential segregation. Consumers prefer more for the district attribute and neighborhood conditions than the distance from the city center, thus the residential segregation in Xipsilaan hold a mixed structure which is mainly fan-shaped and mosaic shaped, and less concentric shaped. Moreover, the study proves that the role of government on residential segregation is greater than real estate developers. Hence, to control or weaken the tendency, we must depend on government intervening.

articleTitle: Research on the value achievement model of the Chinese aerospace enterprise capability
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the analysis of value achievement of the Chinese aerospace enterprise, this paper expatiates the connotation and characteristics of facing the value achievement of the Chinese aerospace enterprise capability, and establishes the value target function of Chinese aerospace enterprise, and constructs ability system of Chinese aerospace enterprise, and constitutes the fuzzy evaluation model, and estimates the ability, and establishes ldquoability achievement valuerdquo as the mathematics function model of Chinese aerospace enterprise, and then designs a comparing method between the ldquoability achievement valuerdquo and the value target of an aerospace enterprise.

articleTitle: Estimation of optimal advertising expenditure based on customer value
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper mainly talks about optimal advertising expenditure based on customer value. Building on earlier work, this thesis develops a customer value model to analyze the relationship between advertisement and customer value. The relationship illustrates that advertisement promotes selling through enhancing customer value and improving the transfer of customer to upper customer value group. This paper establishes the quantitative relationships between advertising expenditure and the rates of each customer value group, sale and market share according to transfer model of customer value. At last, this paper establishes the predicted model of multi-objective advertising expenditure by the method of goal programming. The model considers many-sided requirements of the company at the same time and it can be changed smartly according to the concrete requirements of company, so it is adaptive and practical.

articleTitle: Intellectual capital’s leverage on corporate market value
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The first hypothesis proves that there is a correlation between intellectual capital and market value in Chinese capital market. The correlation is significant over the entire examined period. What this strong correlation further implies is that Chinese listed companypsilas perceived value, to a certain extent, in today knowledge economy, is related to the companypsilas intellectual capital. The second hypothesis has been proven to be correct. There is a correlation between IC Multiplier and intellectual capital. The results prove that the companies in information and technology industry do not have enough structural capital to exploit the value of its employeespsila. This is something we consider alarming since the knowledge intensity is increasing within the companies and in the whole economy of today. However, the IC Multiplier is not low in another three industries, but the structural capital still constrains the employees. We think the main reasons are human capital donpsilat leverage with structural capital effectively that creates the value. Organization capital and relation capitals of most Chinese listed companies are not suitable for the depositing and converting of the employeespsila knowledge, which constrains employeespsila value creation potential. Being short of the internal atmosphere which helps the knowledge to be communicated, converted and shared among the employees and within the company is another reason.

articleTitle: Financial risk analysis in the background of fluctuations in the real estate economy
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The real estate industry is one of important pillar industries of our national economy. The real estate industry is also a fund intensity industry, and it is closely related to the financial system.. Fluctuations, as a property of the real estate economy, are bound to make an impact on the financial system, leading to great financial risks, and even to a financial crisis, if not under proper control or management. This paper probes into the cause and reasons for financial risks based on the analysis on loan risks involved in real estate development and mortgage risks related to housing purchase; this thesis also makes suggestions regarding policies whose purpose is to prevent financial risks.

Author Keywords: ways of financial back-up and support

articleTitle: The tragedy of the anticommons in government public management and the establishment of the system of “super ministry” in China
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The tragedy of the anticommons refers to a situation in which when all right holders with exclusion rights to a property exercise such rights, the property will remain underused or idle. When the functions to provide a public goods or service are partitioned among different organs and when these organs exercise their exclusion rights and thus make the public goods or service unavailable, the tragedy of the anticommons in government public management results and in China it happens mainly because of the overlapping of the functions of different administrative agencies (here mainly referred to parallel agencies) and their conflicting policies. This can by tested by Parisi model. To avoid such tragedy, China is carrying out administrative reform and institutional restructuring in the hope to consolidate different government organs with overlapping functions and to integrate their powers. To ensure the success of the reform, the principle of check and balance should be honored so as to standardize the behaviors of government institutions.

articleTitle: Characteristics and sources of leadership culture of entrepreneurs
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: A study of comparison of leadership cultures of Chinese and German entrepreneurs was conducted. The result was compared with the results of the GLOBE leadership culture study and the Hofstedepsilas national culture study. The purpose of the comparison was to find out sources of the entrepreneurial leadership culture and their characteristics of Chinese and German. The analysis included three steps. First, the researcher used measurement equivalence test to ensure the comparability of Chinese and German samples. Second, the researcher used the mean structure model of SEM and explored leadership culture differences between China and Germany. Then at last, differences of the entrepreneurial leadership culture, the GLOBE leadership culture, and the Hofstedepsilas national culture in and across China and Germany were discussed. Two key sources of the entrepreneurial leadership culture were found: national culture value and group traits.

articleTitle: Research on pricing risks control of merger and acquisition based on game theory
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The target firms pricing process is divided into objective value assessment, value-added measure of merger and acquisition (M&A), pricing interval estimation and game pricing four parts. The paper points out that the main risks come from incorrect value assessment of target firm and information dissymmetry between the buyer and the seller. So the paper adopted two levels of dynamic risk control strategies. First, control the target enterprise valuation assessment risk through diligence investigation and reasonable choice of parameters; Second, control the information dissymmetrical risk in price negotiations by establishing game negotiations model. The model uses game theory to study the negotiation ideas of both sides and pricing tactics under asymmetric information conditions. The optimal judgments and tactics combinations are given by Bayesian Nash equilibrium when the pricing right is in different negotiatorpsilas hands. Finally, the game negotiation model is applied to the case of Tai Ji Group buying South-west Pharmacy, and explains the reasons why Tai Ji Group refused the first quoted price and accepted the second quoted price. The case proves the effectiveness of theories and methods put forward by this paper.

articleTitle: A study on the choice of process innovation model of manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: From the perspective of enterprise strategy, this paper discussed leading process innovation, imitative process innovation, secondary process innovation and the advantages and disadvantages of them. From the perspective of product life cycle, this paper discussed the characters of process innovation at the beginning stage, growth stage, mature stage and regenerate stage (decline stage). From the perspective of enterprisepsilas scale, this paper discussed process innovation mode of large, medium and small enterprises. From the perspective of dynamical mechanism, this paper discussed process innovation mode from the angles of external source and internal source.

articleTitle: Measurement of technology heterogeneity by metafronter
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The gaps between the metafrontier production function and the firm-specific frontier production function is caused mainly by the technology heterogeneity or the difference in technology and production techniques employed by different firms. Different from the routine way to estimate the technology gaps by data envelopment analysis, this study uses the varying coefficients regression model to estimate the metafrontier function, the firm-specific frontier and the technology gaps simultaneously with the reproduced input-output data, which is shown to be an approximate piecewise Cobb-Douglas. The proposed method is then applied in the analysis of panel data on Chinese 33 industries from 2000 to 2003, and the result shows that the difference of technology gaps between industries is quite considerable in China.

articleTitle: The relationship between firm size and R&D expenditure: The mediating role of managerial discretion
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The paper introduces managerial discretion as a mediating variable in the relationship between firm size and R & D expenditure. Based on the relevant literature review and theoretical analysis, two hypotheses about the relationship among firm size, managerial discretion and R&D expenditure are proposed. With the data of 213 listed firms revealing R&D expenditure in China, the paper comprehensively adopts the methods of linear estimation, curve estimation and hierarchical regression in empirical analysis, and finally concludes that, (1) managerial discretion is significantly negatively related with firm size; (2) R&D expenditure in fund (RDIF) is positively related with firm size, while R&D expenditure in personnel (RDIP) is slightly negatively related with firm size; and (3) managerial discretion can mediate the relationship between firm size and RDIF, while its mediation effect on the relationship between firm and RDIP is insignificant.

articleTitle: The game mechanism analysis of CPA participating in earnings management
publicationTitle: 2008 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering 15th Annual Conference Proceedings
